proposed_decision.rule: Generate 2-3 candidate G-ID forms for each of the 40 locked Wave 01 semantic slots using the approved semantic-first, G-ID-first, Phonotactic Profile V2 and collision-review contracts. Generation produces review options only; no candidate is selected or registered by this gate.

governance_decisions.proposal: Use NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as default lane and do not exploit -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or other observed families as productive morphology without a separate approved rule.

Each option must expose slot ID, concept reference, G-ID sequence, IPA, safe romanization only where fully governed, phonotactic notes, exact-collision result, near-collision result and morphology-false-friend result.

Reject exact collisions against recovered and authored registries. Near collisions may remain only when explicitly flagged for human review. No option may silently reuse HOLD, GATE, BRIDGE, REFERENCE or dependency-blocked forms.
Preserve ON, KUON, MAMA and PAPA linked slots outside Wave 01 candidate generation. This gate neither resolves nor supersedes them.

After generation, prepare a separate Wave 01 human selection gate. No generated option receives registry status, HNK3000 credit, FROZEN authority, curriculum binding or runtime use before that later selection/registration flow.

governance_decisions.approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-HNK3000-W01-GEN-001 through DEC-HNK3000-W01-GEN-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not select or register generated forms, assign HNK3000 credit, resolve HOLD seeds, approve B16, or alter L03 curriculum/runtime.
